decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: East slot 1, Central slot 2, North slot 3, West slot 4, South slot 5
a legend instead of end labels: the label of South would move 1.8 line heights from its line (at most 1.5 with a leader) (G5.3, G5.7)
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
the unit phrase on the top label: “120 employees”; the top gridline starts after it
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
legend entries in the order of the lines at the latest point: East, Central, North, West, South
the legend at the right of the plot, beside the latest values, centred on the plot

findings.message: the unit phrase “employees” is one word; say what is counted, which subset and per what period

source.shows: synthetic data: five regions ending within four employees of one another; packed, the outer labels would move more than a line and a half from their lines, so the chart takes a legend at the right, in the order of the line ends (G5.3, G5.9, G5.11)
